projects.title: NAS Access Reporting Automation
projects.description: Built a Python and pandas workflow that merged NAS share data with user, owner, and support-contact records from multiple sources. The script cleaned inconsistent fields, identified missing ownership details, and produced review-ready Excel reports that reduced manual cleanup and supported access-remediation work.

projects.title: PvE Extraction Dungeon
projects.description: Building a class-based PvE extraction dungeon crawler in Roblox where players enter with a selected class, clear procedurally assembled rooms, collect gear, and decide when to extract. The project includes persistent lobby storage, item loss on death, room voting, enemy variants, loot, hazards, and modular server-side systems for combat, damage, and dungeon flow.

projects.title: Three-Level Unity Platformer
projects.description: Built a three-level 2D platformer in Unity with responsive movement, jumping, a directional dash, hazards, button-activated platforms, goal triggers, and scene transitions. I also added a persistent death counter, sound effects, particles, and feedback systems, then structured the levels so each one introduced and combined the core mechanics more deliberately.

projects.title: Monopong
projects.description: Built a physics-based arcade game where the player rotates a single paddle around a circular arena to keep the ball in play. I tuned the paddle movement and collision behavior, then added a three-life system, sound effects, particles, and camera shake to make the simple core mechanic feel more responsive and readable.
